authority: Repairs operational record shape and states observed readiness gaps; does not grant memory authority, certify hidden targets, judge model quality, or claim an FBM dataset or behavioral result.
failure_or_lesson: A procedure row that follows most of a schema can still omit its authority boundary. Shape validation preserves reusable audit evidence, but concrete inputs, choice sets, independent targets, outcomes and split lineage are still needed for trainable builder cases.
goal: Repair omitted operation authority and keep procedure seeds distinct from supervised builder cases.
notes: Pre-repair baseline had 18 unique rows, of which 13 lacked authority. This repair adds one linked method trace, not a supervised training case.
procedure: Compare the captured JSONL fields with the active trace schema; add only the permitted scope and limits of each deficient operation; reject missing authority, duplicate stable IDs, ambiguous UTC timestamps and unknown schema values; retain the linked-case and qualified-model boundaries.
validation: The validator checked all 18 pre-existing rows after repairing 13 omitted authority fields. Three local regressions passed for repository records, missing authority/duplicate IDs, and ambiguous dates/unrecognized training labels. Selected-backend CI is not evidence supplied by this seed.
